players.product: utility T&D grid infrastructure (transmission/substation connectors and hardware up to 765 kV, System Control control houses) and data-center electrical components (Burndy connectors, PCX power skids, 800 V pin & sleeve devices)

quarterly_data.signal: Hubbell's second-quarter 2026 earnings release reports Utility Solutions Grid Infrastructure net sales up approximately 12% and Grid Automation net sales up approximately 1%. Utility Solutions segment operating income was $234 million (22.8% of net sales) versus $218 million (23.3%) in the second quarter of 2025, and adjusted operating income $263 million (25.6%) versus $239 million (25.5%). Electrical Solutions, a segment that also includes heavy industrial and residential markets, had segment operating income of $115 million (16.7%) versus $118 million (21.5%), and adjusted operating income $146 million (21.2%) versus $124 million (22.5%).
